messages:
omar: Heads up — seeing a big backlog in us-west-2 for inference queue A. Small low-p99 jobs are stuck behind one huge allocation, GPUs are 100% on some hosts while a bunch of nodes are idle. Grafana: https://graf.redwood/g/inqA/us-west-2 (short link)
jana: oof. Is this the admission controller or scheduler? any errors in scheduler logs?
sre-bot: Incident detected: queue_delay_threshold exceeded on cluster-us-west-2. alert_id=INC-20260315-32
omar: scheduler logs show repeated "attempt_allocate: waiting on slot" for job id job-122542 (requested 64 GPUs), then nothing else is scheduled behind it. snippet:
```
2026-03-15T14:12:03Z scheduler alloc.go:214 INFO attempt_allocate job-122542 reqGPUs=64 state=queued
2026-03-15T14:12:03Z scheduler alloc.go:218 INFO comparator returned -1 for job-122543 vs job-122542
2026-03-15T14:12:04Z scheduler alloc.go:219 INFO blocked_head job-122542
```
looks like head-of-line blocking: comparator mismatch? comparator should prefer small latency jobs when they fit but it's returning wrong ordering.
kai: I pulled a dev build and ran unit tests against the priority comparator. Found a sign bug in compareRequestFit() — when job.extra_priority == 0 it returns the raw difference instead of absolute fit priority. patch incoming.
mike: can we hotfix with an admission cap? e.g., max_per_job_gpus=16 in the admission controller to stop 64-GPU jobs from monopolizing until we patch.
jana: if we cap, we should also add a temporary route rule to send large jobs to dedicated capacity in eu-west-1 so customer jobs don't stall.
lucy: pushing a config change to prod: set max_per_job_gpus=16 on us-west-2 admission controller. Will do a canary on 2 schedulers first. /cc @kai patch ready for scheduler
(2 minutes)
lucy: canary looks good, no config errors. rolling to remaining schedulers.
kai: pushed comparator fix to main, will compile and push a hotfix of scheduler binary. change: use signed comparison on fitScore and treat equal fit as lower GPU first.
sre-bot: Deploy started: scheduler-hotfix-v0.9.7 -> us-west-2 (rolling)
omar: after admission cap + hotfix, backlog dropped 87%, p95 latency for small jobs back to normal. GPUs more balanced, see quick dashboard: https://graf.redwood/g/inqA/us-west-2?from=14:00&to=14:30
jana: nice. let's schedule a short postmortem: reproduce steps, add unit tests for comparator, and add an e2e that simulates mix of small/large jobs.
kai: adding tests now. Also adding telemetry to detect future head-of-line patterns: measure time head_job_blocks_others > 30s.
mike: follow up ops runbook item: if one job requests > 32 GPUs, automatically mark it for placement on dedicated pool unless team overrides.
lucy: created internal ticket INFRA-4513 for runbook + add-on telemetry. Assigning to @mike and @jana.
omar: Thanks all — good catch. keeping thread open for postmortem notes and customer follow-ups
